name: grep-and-glob
description: Exercise grep (basic, case-insensitive, path filter, no match) and glob.

name: grep-options
description: Exercise grep gitignore, negation glob, line-range selector, multiline regex, invalid regex, missing path, and skip pagination.
setup:
mkdir -p src/deep node_modules/x many && printf 'foo one
bar
foo two
' > src/a.txt && printf 'foo deep
' > src/deep/b.txt && printf 'foo ignored
' > node_modules/x/c.txt && printf 'node_modules/
' > .gitignore && printf 'foo hidden
' > .h.txt && for i in $(seq 1 150); do printf 'needle %s
' $i > many/f$i.txt; done && find . -exec touch -t 202001010000 {} + && git init -q .

name: glob-options
description: Exercise glob limit, hidden, gitignore, bare dir, semicolon multi-pattern, no match, empty args, and limit=0.
setup: mkdir -p src/deep node_modules/x many && printf a > src/a.txt && printf b > src/deep/b.txt && printf c > node_modules/x/c.txt && printf 'node_modules/\n' > .gitignore && printf h > .h.txt && for i in $(seq 1 30); do printf n > many/f$i.txt; done && find . -exec touch -t 202001010000 {} + && git init -q .

name: find-semantic
description: Exercise semantic find with find.enabled: on and deterministic loopback chat-judge responses (yes).

name: grep-archive
description: Exercise grep on archive members: zip, tar.gz, jar, mixed with plain file, missing member/archive, corrupt/truncated archives, directory members, two members from one archive, binary, non-UTF-8, all unreadable, and line ranges.
setup:
python3 -c 'import zipfile, tarfile, io
with zipfile.ZipFile("bundle.zip", "w") as z:
    z.writestr("src/", "")
    z.writestr("src/foo.ts", "line one\nconst alpha = 1;\nline three\nconst alpha = 2;\nline five\n")
    z.writestr("src/bar.ts", "const alpha = 99;\n")
    z.writestr("bin.dat", b"alpha\x00binary\n")
    z.writestr("badutf8.txt", b"alpha \xff\xfe invalid\n")
with zipfile.ZipFile("lib.jar", "w") as z:
    z.writestr("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF", "Manifest-Version: 1.0\nMain-Class: com.example.Alpha\n")
with tarfile.open("release.tar.gz", "w:gz") as t:
    data = b"Release notes\nalpha feature\nomega feature\nalpha second\n"
    info = tarfile.TarInfo("notes.md")
    info.size = len(data)
    t.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(data))
raw_zip = open("bundle.zip", "rb").read()
open("trunc.zip", "wb").write(raw_zip[:20])
' && printf 'plain alpha line
' > plain.txt && printf 'not a zip file
' > corrupt.zip && printf 'not a gzip file
' > corrupt.tar.gz && printf 'not a tar file
' > corrupt.tar && find . -exec touch -t 202001010000 {} +
